basic_info.description: Live above it all in this stylish 2BD/2.5BA, 2-level condo in a boutique 3-unit building on the Potrero Hill/Inner Mission border. The open main level features hardwood floors, fireplace, oversized windows, and abundant natural light. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, granite countertop, and generous storage. A convenient half bath and space to set up an office complete the floor. Upstairs, both bedrooms open to a massive private deck with sweeping Twin Peaks views - the perfect backdrop for a night cap around the fire pit. The primary suite features ample closets and a spa-like bath with soaking tub and walk-in shower. Amenities include in-unit laundry, secure garage parking, storage, and rare direct access to a landscaped backyard. Ideally located on a wide tree-lined street, minutes from the Mission District, 24th Street corridor, Zuckerberg General, and commuter routes (I-280, US-101, public transit). Don't miss this rare opportunity!
